GameSpew
Stellar Blade: Complete Edition on Switch 2 isn't the best way to experience Shift Up's thrilling action adventure title, but it's still a must-play if it's the only way you can play or value the flexibility that it offers.

Nov 2, 2026
90
Noisy Pixel
Must-Play Stellar Blade: Complete Edition brings its satisfying combat and stylish action to Nintendo Switch 2 with surprisingly few gameplay compromises. While reduced visual fidelity and uncomfortable Joy-Con 2 controls hold it back, the complete package and excellent Bayonetta collaboration make this an impressive port that proves Eve's adventure is just as enjoyable on Nintendo hardware.
Nintendo Switch 2 FULL REVIEW
Nov 3, 2026
80
Nintendo News PL
Stellar Blade remains a brilliant slasher, but this Switch 2 port requires playing through slightly gritted teeth. While the handheld visuals are impressive, the input lag caused by the implementation of Frame Generation affect the precision of the parry system. The foundation for future patches is solid, but for now, hardware limitations might cause more deaths than the bosses themselves.
Nintendo Switch 2 FULL REVIEW
Nov 3, 2026
80
COGconnected
The Switch 2 version of Stellar Blade is competent but struggles to hit the same heights as the original. With its steady framerate, the game runs extremely well both docked and handheld. While it’s incredible that Shift Up has managed to get the game working on Nintendo’s latest hardware, some compromises have been made. Animations dip at a distance and the game isn’t as responsive as the original. It may not be the best version of the game, but it remains a worthwhile option for those who want to experience EVE’s adventure on the go.
Nintendo Switch 2 FULL REVIEW

Hobby Consolas
Stellar Blade Complete Edition continues the upward trend of quality ports on Switch 2. Shift-Up has released a more than competent version packed with content, new features and minor updates for a hack-and-slash game that, whilst not perfect, is highly addictive.
Nintendo Switch 2 FULL REVIEW
Nov 2, 2026
70
Nintendo Life
Despite some drawbacks, Stellar Blade stands tall as an impressive and enjoyable action game that occupies a nice niche in the Switch 2 library. Rewarding exploration, thrilling combat, and tough but fair difficulty carry this game far and make it an easy recommendation, even if its story can be a bit bland and the visuals aren’t always up to the task. I’d recommend this to anyone looking for a higher-budget game that favours exploration and combat; Stellar Blade excels in its implementation of both and makes a great first impression as Shift Up’s entrance into AAA game development.
Nintendo Switch 2 FULL REVIEW
